data.text:
🌍 Global Security Outlook – 15 May 2026

MIDDLE EAST

🇮🇷 Iran – CENTCOM assessed Iran’s military threat capability as significantly degraded but not eliminated following the 38-day U.S. bombing campaign.

🇮🇷 Iran – Iranian authorities reportedly seized a vessel off the UAE coast and directed it toward Iranian waters amid renewed Strait of Hormuz tensions.

🇮🇷 Iran – Tehran announced that all ships entering the Strait of Hormuz must “cooperate” with Iranian authorities following the latest maritime seizure incident.

🇦🇪 United Arab Emirates – Iran accused the UAE of acting as an “active partner” in the U.S.–Israeli war effort, further escalating Gulf diplomatic tensions.

🇱🇧 Lebanon – Israel and Lebanon continued direct talks involving border security, Israeli military activity, and the future disarmament of Hizbollah.

🇮🇱 Israel – Israel announced efforts to extend the operational range of its F-35I “Adir” fleet as contingency planning against Iran continues.

🇴🇲 Oman – A cargo vessel near Oman reportedly sank after an attack linked to escalating regional maritime insecurity.

EAST ASIA & PACIFIC

🇨🇳 China – Xi Jinping warned President Trump that mishandling the “Taiwan question” could lead to direct confrontation between China and the United States.

🇹🇼 Taiwan – Beijing intensified rhetoric toward Taiwan, warning Washington of potential “clashes and conflicts” if U.S. support for Taipei expands.

🇵🇭 Philippines – Japan conducted its first-ever anti-ship missile firing from Philippine territory during Exercise Balikatan 2026.

🇯🇵 Japan – Japanese missile forces sank a decommissioned Philippine naval vessel in a live-fire demonstration in the South China Sea.

EUROPE & EURASIA

🇺🇦 Ukraine – Russia launched a major overnight missile and drone barrage on Kyiv, killing at least 10 people and damaging infrastructure.

🇺🇦 Ukraine – Ukrainian authorities expanded a high-profile corruption investigation involving former senior presidential aide Andrii Yermak.

🇺🇦 Ukraine – Kyiv and Washington advanced plans for U.S.-based joint drone manufacturing ventures using Ukrainian wartime technology.

AFRICA

🇸🇩 Sudan – AFRICOM warned that U.S. intelligence and surveillance limitations in Africa could reduce warning time for emerging external terror threats from Sahel-based extremist groups.

🇲🇱 Mali – U.S. military officials expressed concern that Islamic State and Al-Qa’ida affiliates in the Sahel continue expanding operational capability despite reduced Western visibility in the region.

WESTERN HEMISPHERE

🇨🇴 Colombia – U.S. Coast Guard forces intercepted three cocaine-smuggling boats near Cartagena in a single day of counter-narcotics operations.

🇺🇸 United States – U.S. Southern Command continued kinetic strikes against suspected drug-running vessels in the Caribbean and eastern Pacific.

GLOBAL DEFENSE & SECURITY

🇺🇸 United States – The U.S. Navy warned Operation Epic Fury war costs could force training reductions, operational cuts, and personnel impacts by July without supplemental funding.

🇺🇸 United States – U.S. Army infantry units in Lithuania expanded live drone warfare experimentation focused on both drone employment and counter-drone tactics.

🇺🇸 United States – Pentagon officials disputed a Congressional Budget Office estimate projecting the Golden Dome missile defense program could exceed $1.2 trillion over 20 years.

🇳🇴 Norway – Norway canceled a Naval Strike Missile contract with Malaysia after implementing new arms-export restrictions.

🇺🇸 United States – Lockheed Martin received an additional $407 million for Guam missile defense integration, bringing the contract total to approximately $1.9 billion.
